screen.title: Responsibility Contract
screen.body:
I promise to take good care of my virtual pup, every single day:

• I will feed it when it is hungry.
• I will give it fresh water every day.
• I will take it for walks to keep it fit and healthy.
• I will clean up after it and keep it clean.
• I will act on warnings before it gets sick or has to go to the virtual shelter.

Do you accept this responsibility?
